exposure: third-year resident performing the spinal block
seniority of resident performing spinal block
outcome: neonatal Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: 110 patients with failed spinal anesthesia and 330 control patients undergoing cesarean delivery at a university hospital in Thailand
finding: Total spinal anesthesia failure was related to a patient BMI ≤29.5 kg/m2 and a third-year resident performing the spinal block.
